_comment: Ported from the retired lighthouserc.cjs. Keys without a prefix are ceilings on the median
sample; keys prefixed 'category:' are floors on the Lighthouse category score (0-1).
'default' applies to every route; entries under 'routes' are keyed by the route TEMPLATE
from @transcendence/web-routes, not by URL path, so a dynamic route needs its template form.
Data-dense routes get their own headroom rather than being held to the homepage's numbers.
